A quick, tasty weeknight option is **Garlic‑Lemon Shrimp Pasta**.  
**Ingredients** (serves 2): 8 oz spaghetti, 12 oz peeled shrimp, 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), zest and juice of 1 lemon, ¼ cup chopped parsley, salt, pepper, red‑pepper flakes (optional).  
**Steps**: 1️⃣ Cook pasta al dente; reserve ½ cup pasta water. 2️⃣ While pasta cooks, heat oil in a skillet over medium‑high, add garlic (and flakes) 30 s, then shrimp 2‑3 min per side until pink. 3️⃣ Stir in lemon zest, juice, and reserved pasta water; toss with cooked pasta. 4️⃣ Mix in parsley, season with salt/pepper. Serve immediately.
